title: Q-STD-supply-chain: Attest builds, publish SBOM, run Scorecard
body:
**Owner:** executor
**Trigger:** executor tick, driver order
**Done check:** cmd:python3 -m foundation openstd --probe supply-chain
**Status:** closed

OPEN-STANDARDS-1 (Rowan, 2026-11-25): add GitHub build attestations (SLSA, Sigstore) to deploy-ultrastable, publish a CycloneDX or SPDX SBOM, and run OpenSSF Scorecard weekly.

size: M
**Out of scope:** new formats not in doctrine/open-standards.json.

Prediction: open_standards_adopted_rows >= 10 within 168 h

**Closing probe:** python3 -m foundation openstd --check passes and the registry row for supply-chain reads adopted with evidence files that exist.

**Disposition:** shelved (ttl, 2026-11-26T12:44:52Z, DISPOSE-1)

**Evidence:** open 6.1 hours (limit 6 hours) and no loop closed it (SLA-8H-1). Its closing probe still runs on every fleet pass and records `fixed` when it passes; the executor retries it when its open queue is empty (every 30 days at most).
